plan.notes: program_type professional-phase: the official College of Business major checklist sequences only the upper-division professional phase (junior/senior years, 4 terms). The full degree requires 120 credits; Silver Core GE and the pre-business core are completed first and listed in external_prereqs. The official checklist publishes course codes without course titles; the code is repeated as the title. See catalog.unr.edu for official titles. Online delivery variant of the General Business major. The checklist prints no catalog year (dated 5-22-23, same series as the 2023-2024 checklists); filed as 2023-2024. Bold courses on the checklist are regularly available online; other courses may fulfill the area but are not consistently available online. MGT 496 prerequisites: ENG 102; CH 201/202/203/212; MGT 301 or 323; FIN 301; SCM 352.

courses.title: Gen Bus Upper Elective
courses.choice_note: Upper-division (300-499) General Business elective (3 CR): any ACC, BUS, IS, ECON, ENT, FIN, MGT, MKT, SCM, or SPTM course. CO11 courses cannot double-dip. Not all options are available online.
